intro: A big Substitute doll sits on a GTS pedestal!
title: The Super GTS
description:
Oh, a Super GTS! A chance to turn your useless items into treasure!
What interesting trades will happen today?

1.label: Small Item Trade
1.tooltip: (+) Send 5 items of the same tier and choose 1 of 3 items a tier higher
1.disabledTooltip:
(-) 5 items of one tier,
Rogue Ball tier or below,
and reward items left

2.label: Bulk Item Trade
2.tooltip: (+) Send 10 items of the same tier and choose 1 of 5 items two tiers higher (Master Ball at most)
2.disabledTooltip:
(-) 10 items of one tier,
Ultra Ball tier or below,
and reward items left

3.label: Leave
3.selected:
There's no time to trade today!
You continue on.
